title: Sign-valued permuted Maiorana–McFarland function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\pi$ be a permutation of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $g:\mathbb F_2^n\to\{\pm1\}$. For each pair of blocks $(x,y)\in\mathbb F_2^n\times\mathbb F_2^n$, the function $(-1)^{x\cdot\pi(y)}g(y)$ has absolute value $1$.
